newsitem.title: LATVIA: BOURSE MARKET CAPITALISATION ROSE IN MAY.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE MARKET CAPITALISATION ROSE IN MAY.

text.p: The market capitalisation of the Latvian stock exchange rose slightly in May to stand at 151.17 million lats at the end of the month versus 147.09 million lats at the start of the month, the bourse said on Friday.
It said the largest trade turnover was 124,820 lats in the middle of the month and the smallest was 40,198 lats at the end of the month.
The most traded share in May was Unibanka with 360,024 lats of turnover and the smallest was Metalserviss at 0.5 lats.
